item.description: I was featured in @washingtonpost this weekend for my work on the state of heterosexuality and the gender war. @shadihamid and I discussed how digital narratives have fractured our relationship with desire and the possibilities we still have to repair it. Thank you to Shadi for the thoughtful interview and to @jelani.rice for the photos of me in my home.

item.description: ‼️Is it “Okay” to Like Men? (W/ Magdalene J. Taylor)‼️Senior editor at Playboy, Magdalene J. Taylor, returns to Bad Faith to discuss her viral (and somewhat infamous) New York Times essay, “There’s Nothing Wrong With Wanting Men.” Responding to a trend toward “hetero-pessimism,” or a cynical feeling that heterosexual relationships are beyond repair due largely to something ‘wrong’ with men, she offers a counter argument: There’s never been a better time to be straight. Reasonable minds can disagree. You can read her opinion piece here: /6/5/31/opinion/heteropessimism-straight-dating-love.htmlSubscribe to Bad Faith on YouTube (/c/badfaithpodcast) for video of this episode. item.description: Episode 55- Inside the Manosphere (w/ @magdajtaylor)Writer, cultural critic, & senior editor at Playboy Magdalene Taylor joins Bad Faith to discuss the viral new Manosphere documentary by Louis Theroux and what it reveals about gender politics, sex, male loneliness, & late stage capitalism. But first, a Very Millenial™ detour into the controversy following early-aughts Jezebel journalist Lindy West’s new book Adult Braces: Are polyamorous relationships and Manosphere “one-way monogomy” arrangements left/right versions of the same impulse?Subscribe to Bad Faith on YouTube for video of this episode. Find Bad Faith on Twitter (@badfaithpod) and Instagram (@badfaithpod).Produced by Armand Aviram.Theme by Nick Thorburn (@nickfromislands).

item.title: Welcome to the dating panopticon.What happens when every misstep...
item.description: Welcome to the dating panopticon.What happens when every misstep has the potential to go viral? In this episode, tech journalist @tanyenorth and sex and culture writer @magdajtaylor break down the dating panopticon — a world where love, gossip, and surveillance collide.From ghosting etiquette to the hacked Tea App, we explore how online whisper networks meant to protect women have turned into digital minefields, and what it takes to opt out of turning our romantic lives into content. And, we rehash the ancient, cautionary tale of the one and only West Elm Caleb.Listen now in the link in bio, or wherever you get your podcasts!#closealltabs #closealltabspodcast #surveillance #storytime #datingstories #tea

item.description: My guest this week is Magdalene Taylor, a writer, cultural critic and senior editor at Playboy. Magdalene has made a name for herself as one of the most astute critics of modern romance and especially its intersection with technology. She famously blames the phones!In this segment, we discuss the impact of AI on the “economy of naked women”The full interview is on YouTube link in bio :)

item.title: I’m going to be joining Playboy for the next six months as Sen...
item.description: I’m going to be joining Playboy for the next six months as Senior Editor. As my assortment of various Playboy paraphernalia (some of which belonged to my grandfather) suggests, this is obviously a dream come true. It’s going to be very sexy, fun and cool. I’ll still be occasionally freelancing and continuing on with the Substack newsletter (which also just recently hit 15k subscribers). Every day there is a new reason to say “yay”
